best_single_selection.criterion: highest complete Train OOF macro-F1 at TTA1

classwise_temperature_probe.note: Sensitivity only; fitting and application both group by predicted class. The primary system uses one global temperature.

delta_vs_best_single_ci.comparison: final selected fusion TTA8 versus selected single TTA1
delta_vs_best_single_ci.note: Delta = final system - best single backbone selected on complete Train OOF TTA1, paired patient-cluster bootstrap

fusion_selection_protocol.group_definition: patient code before the first underscore; repeat biopsies remain in one fold
fusion_selection_protocol.protocol: backbone-level patient-grouped five-fold Train OOF; fusion fit on complete Train OOF; independent Meta-Cal selection

biopsy.bootstrap_unit: patient; all repeat biopsies from a sampled patient are resampled together

inference_cost.measurement: sum of measured terminal Test forward-pass times; JPEG loading is excluded

mcnemar_final_vs_best_single.comparison: final selected fusion TTA8 versus selected single TTA1
mcnemar_final_vs_best_single.selection_source: complete original-Train OOF macro-F1 at TTA1

referral.metacal_probability_source: temperature-scaled independent Meta-Cal probabilities from the selected fusion candidate
referral.selection_rule: lowest threshold with Meta-Cal autonomous accuracy >= 0.90

public_release_projection.privacy_transform: PR precision/recall curves were deterministically downsampled with both endpoints retained; per-item prediction thresholds were omitted.
